title: DisCa: Distillation-Compatible Learnable Feature Caching
summary: A Tencent-developed inference acceleration framework that unifies learnable feature caching with step-distillation for video diffusion transformers. It achieves near-lossless 11.8x speedups, enabling high-fidelity video generation on consumer hardware.
research_notes: Introduces the Restricted MeanFlow distillation scheme to eliminate inter-frame jitter and is specifically optimized for high-resolution Image-to-Video and Text-to-Video workflows.

evolution.summary: Officially accepted to CVPR 2026, DisCa has been fully integrated into the HunyuanVideo-1.5 ecosystem as of May 2026. It evolved from previous Tencent research (TaylorSeer, ToCa, DuCa), transitioning from heuristic-based caching to a learnable neural predictor architecture.
